name: CDFW CRFS combined rockfish, cabezon, greenling and lingcod catch per bottomfish angler

rights.license: CC BY (version not specified in data.gov catalog)

spatial.horizontal_crs: WGS84 transformed service geometry requested for review; original service geometry is Web Mercator EPSG:3857

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly source revision and complete-page check; human review before replacing public sector context

evidence.supports: CDFW describes statewide recreational catch-and-effort survey design and public RecFIN access.

CDFW's public layer metadata defines combined RCGL catch, bottomfish effort, five-year bins, one-minute reported blocks, multi-block allocation, three-trip inclusion rule and CC BY catalog attribution.
Direct service inspection found 4,471 records, the expected catch/effort fields and -9999 missing-period sentinel.

limitations: Combined RCGL catch cannot separate lingcod from rockfish, cabezon or greenling. Bottomfish effort includes modes other than a private recreational boat.
Historical 2004–2024 interview-reported one-minute blocks do not mark exact catches; multi-block trips allocate catch across all reported blocks.
The 2021–2024 CPUA fields are multi-year averages. The Samples field covers the whole period and is not a 2021–2024 denominator. -9999 means unavailable, not zero.
Some service polygons are clipped within nominal blocks. Latitude browse sectors are not management areas, exact fishing locations or MPA clearance.
The catalog gives CC BY without a version-specific terms statement; raw-block redistribution is not approved by this candidate. Publish broad attributed sector counts only.

producer.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife, California Recreational Fisheries Survey

provenance.access_service: CDFW ArcGIS FeatureServer for BIOS ds3185, distributed via California open-data catalog
transformations: Check CDFW service edit timestamp, required schema, complete 4,471-record page count and distinct OBJECTID/BlockBox identifiers.
Transform service polygons to WGS84, inspect clipped block extents and assign their envelope centers to approximate coastal latitude sectors.
Count 2021–2024 positive, zero and unavailable combined-catch and kept-catch blocks separately; publish only broad sector summaries, never raw locations or a fishing target.
